subject.title: feat(android): approve, reject, and remove device pairings from the phone

question: Should Android pairing repair approval and removal of the active phone be supported only with explicit effective-grant disclosure and a dedicated local unpair flow?
rationale: This determines the permanent consent and credential-lifecycle boundary for a security-sensitive remote administration surface; the implementation repair is clear, but accepting a weaker consent or self-removal model is a maintainer policy choice.

options.title: Require safe consent and local unpair
options.body: Disclose the effective grants restored by repair approval, prevent ordinary active-device removal, add a dedicated unpair/sign-out path, and request real-device proof before merge.

options.title: Accept current semantics
options.body: Allow the current repair disclosure and active-device removal behavior, explicitly accepting the consent and interrupted-verification risks.

recommendation.title: Require safe consent and local unpair
recommendation.body: Disclose the effective grants restored by repair approval, prevent ordinary active-device removal, add a dedicated unpair/sign-out path, and request real-device proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The current implementation and its stated Android/Gateway authorization design are authored on this branch by steipete.
